// README: Best-effort LEAN Launcher config for KisBrokerage. The 'kis-paper-*' keys below are read by KisBrokerageFactory via QuantConnect.Configuration.Config.Get(...). These same paper-account keys are also used for US (overseas) trading — KIS scopes app key/secret/account to an account, not a market, so there are no separate 'kis-us-*' keys to configure.
// data-queue-handler: This now genuinely works, verified against a real source-built LEAN Launcher: KisBrokerage implements IDataQueueHandler itself (see KisBrokerage.DataQueueHandler.cs) via a self-hosted REST-polling loop against the real KIS current-price/quote endpoints (KR: inquire-price; US: overseas-price/quotations/price) — NOT a websocket/real-time feed. Expect ~kis-quote-poll-interval-seconds (default 5s) of lag per symbol, not tick-accurate data. See KisBrokerage.DataQueueHandler.cs's doc comment for the full scope note and README.md's 'What's real vs. stubbed' section.
